$comment: EFI fault codes as data (docs/analysis/error-codes.md sections 2 and 3). Shared by the .NET library and the PHP core. Unknown codes: 59 to 899 permanent, 900 to 999 server and retryable, a faultcode ending in SERVER is retryable.
source: Technical specification v5, Table 169, via docs/analysis/error-codes.md

codes.textMe: Došlo je do izuzeća tokom ekstrakcije primljene XML poruke tokom provjere veličine.
codes.textEn: Exception while extracting the XML during the size check.
codes.cause: Body is not well-formed XML or not a SOAP envelope; wrong encoding.

codes.textMe: Primljena XML poruka premašuje dozvoljenu veličinu.
codes.textEn: Message exceeds the allowed size (150 kB).
codes.cause: Too many or too long items.
codes.action: Split the sale into several invoices; enforce the size check before issuing. Blocking: the invoice must not be issued.

codes.textMe: Vrijeme klijenta razlikuje se od vremena servera u minutima više nego što je dozvoljeno (6 sati) ili je vrijeme u budućnosti.
codes.textEn: Client time differs from server time by more than 6 hours, or is in the future.
codes.cause: Wrong system clock or time zone; SendDateTime copied from the original attempt on a resend.
codes.action: Correct the clock; always set SendDateTime to the actual sending time.

codes.textMe: Izuzetak se dogodio tokom ekstrakcije primljene XML poruke tokom provjere XML-a na osnovu XSD-a.
codes.textEn: Exception while extracting the XML during XSD validation.

codes.textMe: Neuspješna potvrda XML poruke.
codes.textEn: XSD validation failed. Also used for VAT-status consistency (in VAT without SameTaxes, or the reverse).
codes.cause: Invalid value format, missing attribute, schema drift between the library and the service.
codes.action: Fix the data or update the library. The fault string names the offending node. Blocking: must not be issued.

codes.textMe: Izuzetak dogodilo se tokom ekstrakcije primljene XML poruke tokom provjere potpisa.
codes.textEn: Exception while extracting the XML during the signature check.

codes.textMe: Element „potpis“ nedostaje u primljenoj XML poruci.
codes.textEn: Signature element missing.

codes.textMe: Element „XML zahtjev“ nedostaje u primljenoj XML poruci.
codes.textEn: Request element missing.
codes.cause: Empty SOAP body or unknown root element.

codes.textMe: Došlo je do izuzeća tokom ekstrakcije XML elementa potpisa tokom provjere potpisa.
codes.textEn: Exception while extracting the signature element.

codes.textMe: Dostavljeno više od jednog XML elementa potpisa.
codes.textEn: More than one signature element.

codes.textMe: Potpisan pogrešan XML element
codes.textEn: Wrong element signed.

codes.textMe: Navedena pogrešna metoda potpisa klijenta.
codes.textEn: Wrong signature method.

codes.textMe: Navedena pogrešna metoda kanonizacije
codes.textEn: Wrong canonicalization method.

codes.textMe: Navedena pogrešna metoda izvoda.
codes.textEn: Wrong digest method.

codes.textMe: Kriptografski potpis pogrešan.
codes.textEn: Signature value does not verify.
codes.cause: Wrong key; message changed after signing; whitespace or namespace changes between signing and sending.
codes.action: Send the exact signed bytes; software defect or wrong key pair.

codes.textMe: Pogrešan proračun izvoda.
codes.textEn: Digest does not match.
codes.cause: Content changed after signing; wrong transforms.

codes.textMe: Pogrešan cjelokupni potpis
codes.textEn: Signature wrong as a whole.

codes.textMe: Postoji više ključnih informacija nego što je potrebno.
codes.textEn: More key information than needed.
codes.cause: KeyInfo contains more than one certificate or extra elements such as KeyValue or the whole chain.

codes.textMe: Priloženi certifikat nije certifikat vrste X509.
codes.textEn: Certificate is not X.509.

codes.textMe: Dostavljeni certifikat nije valjan.
codes.textEn: Certificate not valid.
codes.cause: Not yet valid, wrong key usage, damaged.
codes.action: Check the certificate; obtain a valid one.

codes.textMe: Certifikat nije izdao Registrovani CA
codes.textEn: Certificate not issued by a registered CA.
codes.cause: Self-signed, foreign or demo certificate; production certificate against test or the reverse.
codes.action: Use a certificate from a registered Montenegrin CA for that environment.

codes.textMe: Certifikat je istekao.
codes.textEn: Certificate expired.
codes.action: Renew; resend pending invoices signed with the new key and the original IKOF (BR-I5).

codes.textMe: Uporediti TIN u XML-u s TIN-om u certifikatu
codes.textEn: TIN in the XML differs from the TIN in the certificate.
codes.cause: Wrong seller number configured; certificate of another company.

codes.textMe: Opozvan status certifikata
codes.textEn: Certificate revoked.

codes.textMe: Status certifikata nepoznat
codes.textEn: Certificate status unknown.
codes.cause: Revocation service of the CA not reachable by CIS.
codes.action: Retry with back-off; if it persists, contact the CA.

codes.textMe: Iznos računa prevelik za račun u gotovini
codes.textEn: Amount too large for a cash invoice. Listed in v02 only; absent from the v5 table.
codes.cause: Cash invoice above a legal limit. The anti-money-laundering law forbids physical-cash payments of EUR 10,000 or more (D-19 Art. 65, Q-15); whether the service still checks anything is unknown.
codes.action: Surface the fault string; locally refuse BANKNOTE payments of EUR 10,000 or more (Q-15).

codes.textMe: Kôd poslovne jedinice ne odnosi se na aktivnu poslovnu jedinicu (prostor) poreskog obveznika.
codes.textEn: Business unit code is not an active business unit of the taxpayer.
codes.cause: Typo; unit not registered or closed on the SEP.
codes.action: Register or correct the business unit on the SEP.

codes.textMe: Kôd softvera ne odnosi se na aktivni softver.
codes.textEn: Software code is not an active software.
codes.cause: Typo; software not registered or deactivated.
codes.action: Correct the code; register the software.

codes.textMe: Kôd održavaoca ne odnosi se na aktivnog održavaoca.
codes.textEn: Maintainer code is not an active maintainer.

codes.textMe: Status PDV-a izdavaoca ne odgovara atributu „izdavalac je obveznik PDV-a“.
codes.textEn: Issuer's VAT status does not match IsIssuerInVAT.
codes.cause: Wrong setting; status changed in the register.
codes.action: Fix the setting. Blocking: must not be issued.

codes.textMe: „Važi od“ ne može biti u prošlosti.
codes.textEn: ValidFrom cannot be in the past.
codes.cause: TCR registration with a past date.

codes.textMe: „Važi do“ ne može biti u prošlosti.
codes.textEn: ValidTo cannot be in the past.

codes.textMe: „Važi do“ ne može biti prije „važi od“.
codes.textEn: ValidTo cannot be before ValidFrom.

codes.textMe: Aktivni ENU nije moguće ažurirati.
codes.textEn: An active TCR cannot be updated.
codes.cause: Re-registration tried to change something other than ValidTo or the maintainer code.

codes.textMe: Promjene u datumu i vremenu razlikuju se u minutima od vremena iz Centralnog registra računa više nego što je to dozvoljeno (6 sati).
codes.textEn: ChangeDateTime differs from CIS time by more than the allowed time. In v5 the code appears only in the cash-deposit control table, without the number of hours.
codes.action: Correct the clock; for a late deposit see Q-17 on how SubseqDelivType interacts with this check.

codes.textMe: Iznos gotovine za INITIAL operaciju ne može biti negativan.
codes.textEn: Cash amount for INITIAL cannot be negative.

codes.textMe: Iznos gotovine ne može biti nula za operaciju WITHDRAW.
codes.textEn: Cash amount cannot be zero for WITHDRAW.

codes.textMe: Poreski obveznik ne postoji u Registru poreskih obveznika.
codes.textEn: Taxpayer does not exist in the taxpayer register.
codes.cause: Wrong TIN; not registered in ROF for this environment.
codes.action: Register on the SEP of that environment ([D-03]).

codes.textMe: ENU kôd klijenta ne odnosi se na registrovani ili aktivni ENU ili ENU ne pripada navedenom izdavaču.
codes.textEn: TCR code is not a registered or active TCR, or does not belong to the issuer.
codes.cause: Typo; TCR deregistered; code from the other environment.
codes.action: Register the TCR or correct the code.

codes.textMe: Vrsta identifikacije mora biti TIN (JMB/PIB).
codes.textEn: Identification type must be TIN.

codes.textMe: Poreski obveznik nije aktivan u registru poreskih obveznika.
codes.textEn: Taxpayer is not active in the register.

codes.textMe: Gotovinski depozit s operacijom INITIAL već je registrovan za tekući dan.
codes.textEn: An INITIAL cash deposit is already registered for the current day.
codes.cause: Sent twice; resend after a lost response. The specification also says the initial deposit may be changed until the day's first invoice (BR-D1); when exactly 56 is returned is to be observed (Q-17).
codes.action: Treat as "already done" when the previous attempt's outcome was unknown; otherwise show it.

codes.textMe: Deaktivirani ENU se ne može mijenjati.
codes.textEn: A deactivated TCR cannot be changed.

codes.textMe: Gotovinski depozit s operacijom INITIAL nije registrovan za tekući dan.
codes.textEn: No INITIAL cash deposit is registered for the current day.
codes.cause: A cash invoice was sent from a cash TCR before the day's initial deposit.
codes.action: Register the INITIAL deposit (may be 0.00), then resend the identical invoice. The software must prevent this locally (BR-D5).

codes.textMe: Izuzeci za interni server.
codes.textEn: Internal server errors.
codes.action: Issue the invoice with IKOF only, queue with SubseqDelivType="SERVICE", retry with back-off (BR-O3).
